adjudication.rationale: The diff does change TopicEmbed.import’s category assignment from a global SiteSetting.embed_category to a per-host lookup: `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` then `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If `record_for_host` returns nil (no matching EmbeddableHost row for the URL’s host), the category passed to PostCreator becomes nil, whereas previously it would always use the configured global embed category. The diff also removes the `embed_category` site setting entirely (config/site_settings.yml, server locale) and migrates existing values into EmbeddableHost rows, implying an intentional shift to per-host configuration; whether feed polling can legitimately import items whose link hosts aren’t in EmbeddableHost is not shown in the diff, so the claimed regression for Jobs::PollFeed is plausible but not directly verifiable here.
